name: dbt-semantic
label: dbt Semantic Layer / OLAP
description: Modern data stack — dbt metrics, semantic models, OLAP cube definitions for BI

table_notes.dbt_project: Registry of dbt projects, each scoping a set of models and semantic definitions within a specific database/schema target.
table_notes.dbt_model: Catalogue of dbt models (SQL transformations) with their materialization strategy, column metadata, and upstream dependencies.
table_notes.dbt_semantic_model: Semantic layer abstraction over a dbt model, declaring entities, dimensions, and measures for the metrics layer.
table_notes.dbt_metric: Business metric definitions expressed via the dbt Semantic Layer, including type, filter predicates, and display metadata for BI tools.
table_notes.olap_dimension: Reusable dimension definitions for OLAP cubes, describing how to slice and group fact data with optional hierarchies.
table_notes.olap_cube: OLAP cube definitions linking a fact table to measures and dimensions with optional refresh scheduling for pre-aggregation.

dbt_project.name: id
dbt_project.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the project row

dbt_project.name: name
dbt_project.description: Unique slug name of the dbt project (matches dbt_project.yml name field)

dbt_project.name: description
dbt_project.description: Human-readable summary of what this project models and its business domain

dbt_project.name: db_name
dbt_project.description: Target database (warehouse) where this project materialises its models

dbt_project.name: schema_name
dbt_project.description: Default schema/dataset within the target database for this project's models

dbt_project.name: created_at
dbt_project.description: Timestamp when this project record was first registered

dbt_model.name: id
dbt_model.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the model row

dbt_model.name: project_id
dbt_model.description: References dbt_project.id — the project this model belongs to

dbt_model.name: name
dbt_model.description: Model node name (unique within its project, e.g. stg_orders, fct_revenue)

dbt_model.name: description
dbt_model.description: Human-readable description of what this model computes and its grain

dbt_model.name: schema_name
dbt_model.description: Schema override for this model (falls back to project default when NULL)

dbt_model.name: materialization
dbt_model.description: dbt materialization strategy: view, table, incremental, ephemeral, or snapshot

dbt_model.name: depends_on
dbt_model.description: Array of upstream node identifiers (ref/source) this model depends on

dbt_model.name: columns
dbt_model.description: Column-level metadata as [{name, data_type, description, tests, tags}] from schema.yml

dbt_model.name: tags
dbt_model.description: Array of string tags applied to this model for grouping and selection (e.g. ['finance','daily'])

dbt_model.name: meta
dbt_model.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata dict from the model's meta: block in schema.yml

dbt_model.name: last_compiled_at
dbt_model.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful dbt compile for this model

dbt_semantic_model.name: id
dbt_semantic_model.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the semantic model row

dbt_semantic_model.name: project_id
dbt_semantic_model.description: References dbt_project.id — the project this semantic model is scoped to

dbt_semantic_model.name: name
dbt_semantic_model.description: Unique name of the semantic model within the project (e.g. orders_semantic)

dbt_semantic_model.name: description
dbt_semantic_model.description: Business-facing description of what facts this semantic model exposes

dbt_semantic_model.name: model_id
dbt_semantic_model.description: References dbt_model.id — the underlying dbt model this semantic model wraps

dbt_semantic_model.name: entities
dbt_semantic_model.description: Array of entity definitions [{name, type, expr}] declaring primary/foreign/unique keys

dbt_semantic_model.name: dimensions
dbt_semantic_model.description: Array of dimension definitions [{name, type, expr, label}] for slicing metrics

dbt_semantic_model.name: measures
dbt_semantic_model.description: Array of measure definitions [{name, agg, expr, label}] as building blocks for metrics

dbt_metric.name: id
dbt_metric.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the metric row

dbt_metric.name: project_id
dbt_metric.description: References dbt_project.id — the project that owns this metric definition

dbt_metric.name: name
dbt_metric.description: Unique machine-readable metric name within the project (e.g. monthly_revenue)

dbt_metric.name: description
dbt_metric.description: Business definition of what this metric measures and how it should be interpreted

dbt_metric.name: label
dbt_metric.description: Human-friendly display name shown in BI tools (e.g. 'Monthly Revenue USD')

dbt_metric.name: type
dbt_metric.description: Metric type per dbt Semantic Layer spec: simple, ratio, cumulative, or derived

dbt_metric.name: type_params
dbt_metric.description: Type-specific parameters (e.g. {measure, numerator, denominator} depending on metric type)

dbt_metric.name: filter
dbt_metric.description: Optional WHERE-clause filter applied to the metric before aggregation (dbt filter syntax)

dbt_metric.name: dimensions
dbt_metric.description: Array of dimension names along which this metric can be queried and sliced

dbt_metric.name: meta
dbt_metric.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata dict for BI tool hints, ownership, or SLA info

olap_dimension.name: id
olap_dimension.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the dimension row

olap_dimension.name: name
olap_dimension.description: Machine-readable dimension name used in cube and metric references (e.g. date, region)

olap_dimension.name: label
olap_dimension.description: Human-friendly display name shown in BI tools and pivot tables

olap_dimension.name: dimension_type
olap_dimension.description: Dimension type: categorical, time, or geographic — governs how BI tools render it

olap_dimension.name: source_table
olap_dimension.description: Fully-qualified source table or view providing dimension members (schema.table)

olap_dimension.name: key_column
olap_dimension.description: Column in source_table used as the join key when linking to fact tables

olap_dimension.name: label_column
olap_dimension.description: Column in source_table providing the human-readable member label for display

olap_dimension.name: hierarchies
olap_dimension.description: Ordered hierarchy level definitions [{name, column, label}] for drill-down (e.g. year > quarter > month)

olap_dimension.name: attributes
olap_dimension.description: Additional non-hierarchical attribute columns [{name, column, label}] on this dimension

olap_cube.name: id
olap_cube.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the cube row

olap_cube.name: name
olap_cube.description: Unique cube name used to identify this OLAP definition (e.g. sales_cube)

olap_cube.name: description
olap_cube.description: Business description of what business process this cube models

olap_cube.name: fact_table
olap_cube.description: Fully-qualified fact table or materialized view serving as the cube's grain (schema.table)

olap_cube.name: measures
olap_cube.description: Array of measure definitions [{name, agg, expr, format_string}] pre-aggregated in this cube

olap_cube.name: dimension_ids
olap_cube.description: Array of olap_dimension.id integers representing dimensions attached to this cube

olap_cube.name: refresh_schedule
olap_cube.description: Cron expression or named schedule for pre-aggregation refresh (e.g. '0 3 * * *')

olap_cube.name: last_refreshed_at
olap_cube.description: Timestamp of the most recent completed pre-aggregation refresh for this cube

short_description: Modern data stack — dbt metrics, semantic models, OLAP cube definitions for BI
long_description: Modern data stack — dbt metrics, semantic models, OLAP cube definitions for BI
when_to_use: Use when building applications that need to conform to the dbt Semantic Layer / OLAP standard.
